copy.title: Christmas Coupon Book Printable, Editable PDF: 30 Coupons for Partner, Kids and Family, 5 Blank Coupons and Gift Envelope
copy.description:
A printable Christmas coupon book with 30 ready-written coupons: 10 for a partner, 10 for kids and 10 for family, plus 5 blank coupons you fill in yourself. Easy to edit: type the names in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader, print tonight and you have a personal gift that fits in a stocking.

No Canva, no Templett, no account and no template that expires. The 30 coupons are already written, so you only type the names: open the PDF, click a line, type, print. Every name line takes up to 20 characters, even in capitals: GRANDMA AND GRANDPA fits.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (13-page PDF, US Letter: cover page, 11 pages, thank-you page)
- How to edit, print and assemble (1 page)
- 3 front covers: For My Love, For My Little Elf, For the Family, each with type-in TO and FROM lines (1 page)
- 3 back covers with the fine print and a type-in MADE WITH LOVE BY line (1 page)
- 10 partner coupons (2 pages): breakfast in bed, date night planned by me, sleep in pass and more
- 10 kids coupons (2 pages): stay up 30 minutes late, build a blanket fort, pajama day and more
- 10 family coupons (2 pages): family game night, Sunday dinner on me, help with any project and more
- 5 blank coupons, the same 6.4 x 1.6 in size as the book: type your own title, two lines of detail and the names (1 page)
- Fold-up gift envelope with type-in TO and FROM: 6.6 x 3.0 in panels with 0.25 in gussets for the 6.39 x 2.72 in covers, holds 3 stapled books printed on paper or 2 on cardstock (1 page)

WHAT YOU CAN EDIT
- 96 type-in fields: FOR and FROM on every coupon, TO and FROM on the covers and envelope, and every line of the 5 blank coupons
- The 30 written coupons have fixed wording; the fonts are fixed and cannot be changed
- Leave any line empty to write by hand after printing

HOW IT WORKS
This is a digital download. Nothing will be shipped. After purchase, go to You > Purchases on Etsy and download the PDF. Open it in Adobe Acrobat Reader (free) on a computer, type your names, save, then print at home or at a print shop on US Letter paper at 100%. Cardstock looks best. Each coupon is 6.4 x 1.6 in; cut on the corner marks, stack each book behind its cover and staple or tie with ribbon.

For personal use. Please do not resell or share the file.

Hosting this year too? Pair it with our Christmas Party Games Printable Bundle or the Gingerbread House Decorating Contest Kit, both in the shop.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
